routes.generated: theta0 (--untuned), and a train-only regenerated unit under Branch full: the dev-100 greedy answers are made here at the recipe's generation cap with the engine's greedy_generate and judged by the session's guard (evaluate_checkpoint's record format), then handed to oext_eval like any caller's answers
routes.source_unit: Branch 128, a train-only regenerated unit (LN-12; LN-19; B15 brief Q15): the source unit's stored dev-100 answers and judge records (--dev100-source), checked against the source's COMPLETE.json; the source must be the same arm and seed, evaluate the dev bank at the same checkpoint and have the regenerated unit's adapter fingerprint; only PHTest is generated from the regenerated adapter
routes.unit_eval: a unit that evaluated the dev bank (an arm, a0 or reference unit from engine calibrate, J9, J10, J18): the unit's own dev-100 greedy answers and judge records at the recipe's cap, checked against its COMPLETE.json; --dev100-source is refused

dev100.rule: the source unit folder may be packed in part: these files must be present; every other file present must be one its COMPLETE.json lists, with the listed SHA-256; job.json hashes to the marker's job_sha256

exit_codes.1: a failure after the folder was made (error.txt kept)
exit_codes.2: refused before any folder was made (nothing generated, judged or written)

ledger.rule: this script's stages hold only counts known before any answer exists (prompts, prompt tokens, the cap, items); oext_eval's stages follow its own rule

name: oext_unit

oext.rule: every O-ext rule (the bank, the cap branch, W1-18's cut and flag, O with equal weights, the LN-14 bar) is oext_eval.py's, called and never re-implemented; the module and its settings are pinned here by SHA-256, and the branch is the one those settings hold; a re-pin of oext_eval (a branch, the bank record, W1-18's record, an engine) re-pins this section and this script's SETTINGS_SHA256 literal in the same edit (addendum section 11 point 7); engine Y (addendum section 34 point 3): settings.path names the file at its place in engine Y's pack, where pack_setup.py puts settings/oext_eval_y.json (the SHA-256 here), and module_sha256 is engine X's oext_eval.py, packed unchanged, so the O-ext function is one and the same on both engines

outputs.rule: --out is a new engine-layout folder (job.json, identity.json, dependencies.json, ledger, assets.json, COMPLETE.json last); oext_eval writes its own files at its root; generated dev-100 answers go to dev100/; COMPLETE.json lists every file's SHA-256 and holds counts of prompts and hashes only, never an O value

prepared.rule: the prepared set is read only through its manifest, which must hash to this pin (B10's pin of the stage-1 prepared set); every unit and source unit names the same manifest; the dev bank's over-refusal prompts are the dev part, their count is oext_eval's bank.dev100.prompts

recipes.rule: the recipe is one of the allowed configs (engine Y: B+Qi only, config 37942cf5 from engine Y's tree by engine Y's code, plan.json recipes_y; addendum section 34 points 1 and 3: B, S and G run on engine X with oext_unit.json) and its generation and guard blocks hash to these pins, engine X's pins unchanged (B+Qi's blocks hash to them on engine Y), so every unit, theta0 and the transfer report share one generation cap, one batch size and one judge (addendum section 9: one cap); with --run it is the unit's own recipe (config and training identity)

requirement: addendum section 20 point 5 (the O-ext unit runner, to B15's contract parser job_runner_stage1.oext_unit_contract), section 11 points 1, 7 and 13 (one shared pinned O-ext function; re-pin on the engine stage 1 uses), section 13 (the cap branch from W1-18's record; nothing runs under pending), section 24 point 2 (LN-14's bar at n = 400 read at W1-18's rates); REV4 section 6.3 (LN-12, LN-14, LN-19, LN-24) and B15 brief Q15; addendum section 34 point 3 (gap G1 of block B's pre-flight): this is engine Y's copy (settings/oext_unit_y.json), read by oext_unit_y.py, which pack_setup.py packs on engine Y's pack at scripts/stage1_s1/oext_unit.py with this file at settings/oext_unit.json; it differs from oext_unit.json in engine_x, oext.settings.sha256, recipes.allowed (B+Qi only) and the oext.rule, recipes.rule and requirement texts

seal.rule: every file of the folder is sealed by the kit's block seal; the answer files hold texts; every other file (the summaries included) and the completion record are scanned for every prompt, answer, cut and judge text before COMPLETE.json is written; stdout carries the branch, the route, counts of prompts and file SHA-256 values only; no O value, flag, answer length or judge label is printed

transfer.rule: LN-14 (REV4 section 6.3; addendum section 24 point 2): transfer runs only with --untuned (theta0) and only under Branch 128 with a passing W1-18 record; oext_eval's evaluate_transfer makes the PHTest answers once at the recipe's full cap and judges them full and cut; the bar is W1-18's read at its rates (at n = 400: at least 388 flags agree and the refused count moves by at most 8); a pre-set report only: nothing here reads it back, and the cap branch never switches on it

unit.rule: --run names a complete engine run-one unit whose files and dependency chain verify (the engine's chain check), on this engine's code, the pinned manifest, the development role and the dev split, whose target checkpoint is --checkpoint and which holds that state; its state is restored with its file hashes and adapter fingerprint verified

untuned.rule: theta0 is the policy with its adapter disabled (policy.model.disable_adapter(), the W1 convention of make_untuned_answers.py) for every generation of the pass; the adapter fingerprint is unchanged; the dev bank is read under the development role at this seed (Gate A's untuned unit's seed; greedy decoding draws nothing)
